items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, Bob Burns got it from him. And Noon.

ctx.x: Would they be with name bands? No, no, no. We had them jug bands and guys playing them kazook things. And that was man. And it must be there. And they all up down the canal up down. Where they can house. And nickel the time. Washboards. Washboards. And the guy played that kazook thing. That's where Bob Burns got that from.
